IPL and the Parliament Elections? Branding strategies to mine the two goldmines together
Following the IPL, Lok Sabha elections are slated to happen in the same period. What else can a brand manager ask for in India – the magical cocktail of cricket mixed with politics? For some veterans, it's heaven, but for those who are unprepared, it may be hell as well. While IPL will take over the prime time, elections and discussion will rule the rest of the day. How can brands make the best of these goldmine opportunities to enhance user engagement, reach a massive audience, build a strong brand recall, and improve sales?

Mumbai Indians hit another century in brand new season
The franchise expects to increase IPL sponsorship revenues by 20% in 2024, following a record haul of more than '100 crore in 2023. "We continue to assert sponsorship dominance as we build momentum both on and off the field," the spokesperson said, adding, "We have recorded the best commercial year in the last 17 years of the IPL."
Indian sports industry clock 11 per cent growth in revenue to ₹15,766 crore in 2023
Media spends on sports fell 1% to ₹7,494 crore last year due to a 16% decline in TV ad revenue to ₹4,620 crore, according to the latest edition of the India Sports Sponsorship Report by GroupM ESP. The lower TV ad revenue represents the ad revenue loss suffered by Star Sports from the Indian Premier League (IPL) in 2023.

Byju seeks to refer the dispute over sponsorship rights for arbitration
 During the proceedings of NCLT, counsel appearing for Think & Learn Pvt Ltd, which provides online educational services under the brand name Byju's, informed that it is currently engaged in negotiations with the BCCI to settle the dispute amicably.
ICC may earn up to $150 million in World Cup sponsorship fee
The world cricket governing body has 20 sponsors and partners for ICC World Cup 2023. It has six global partners that are paying $8-10 million for these sponsorship slots. The global partners include MRF Tyres, Booking.com, IndusInd Bank, MasterCard, Aramco and Emirates. IndusInd and MasterCard have come in as global partners following the exit of Byju's and BharatPe. Both Byju's and BharatPe gave up ICC sponsorship due to their financial woes.
ixigo named official co-sponsor of Men’s Asia Cup Cricket 2023
ixigo's collaboration with the Men’s Asia Cup is poised to elevate its visibility to an extensive audience, affirming the brand’s strategic market presence and global visibility, the company stated in a press release. As the official co-sponsor, ixigo will be prominently showcased in multiple key areas in the match venues as well as on TV and OTT through on-ground visibility and awards, it added.
Disney Star seeks premium rates from advertisers for ICC CWC, Asia Cup
Star Sports is asking for Rs 120 crore for co-presenting sponsorship and Rs 90 crore for associate sponsorship opportunities for the World Cup. The broadcaster is asking spot buyers to pay a premium rate of Rs 31 lakh per 10-seconds for India and knockout matches.

This Giving Tuesday, we will be donating $50,000 worth of HEATTECH products to support 3 organizations across the United States to keep people warm.
UNIQLO partners with organizations across the country that support individuals and families experiencing homelessness, by providing new donations and gently used clothing through its RE.UNIQLO program.
Organizations
Department of Homeless Services New York
Donated products will support 3 emergency family sanctuaries in New York City, as well as outreach programs for people experiencing unsheltered homelessness.
The New York City Department of Homeless Services is an agency within the government of New York City that provides services to the homeless, though its ultimate aim is to overcome homelessness. Apart from offering shelter to individuals and families, every night, DSS-DHS’ dedicated homeless outreach staff engage vulnerable New Yorkers in the subway system and on the streets building trust and encouraging them to accept services and shelter. During these efforts, DSS-DHS outreach teams also offer essential items, such as socks and T-shirts, to New Yorkers in need which include donations from UNIQLO.
In November 2023, UNIQLO organized a special event for over 100 people at a family shelter, and was presented with a Certificate of Recognition from the Mayor’s office for their longstanding support to the DHS in New York City. Since 2014, UNIQLO has donated over 300,000 units of clothing.
Los Angeles Mission
Donated products will aid in supporting the LA Mission's outreach events for Thanksgiving and Christmas to support those experiencing homelessness.
LA Mission is a full human-service agency specializing in breaking the cycle of homelessness and poverty by stabilizing these individuals in a safe and spiritual environment. 
Since 2022, UNIQLO started to donate new and gently used clothing to support homeless people that LA Mission serves.
Circle of Hope
Approximately 1,000 Haitian and Venezuelan migrants will stay warm with donated products during New England's winter.
Circle of Hope is a nonprofit organization based in Needham, Massachusetts. The mission of Circle of Hope is to provide infants, children, and adults experiencing homelessness in Boston and Metro West with clothing and necessities in order to preserve and enhance overall health and personal dignity. By continually providing seasonally appropriate clothing, shoes, linens, and hygiene essentials to 25 homeless shelters, healthcare clinics, and community programs, Circle of Hope gives the most vulnerable members of our community the opportunity to protect themselves from the dangers of illness and disease that come from being homeless in New England. Last year, Circle of Hope gave clothing, hygiene essentials, and PPE to more than 22,000 people experiencing homelessness.
Donate through RE.UNIQLO this holiday season!
Through our RE.UNIQLO program, we collect gently used LifeWear items and donate them to local organizations that help those in need of clothing. You can join us in this effort by dropping off your UNIQLO clothing in the RE.UNIQLO bins located in any of our stores.
